# cue/format/testdata/imports.txtar / pkgonly.input (adapted to Lezer)
package foo
==>
SourceFile(
  PackageClause(
    package,
    PackageName(
      Identifier)))

# cue/format/testdata/imports.txtar / attronly.input (adapted to Lezer)
@attr(foo)
==>
SourceFile(
  Attribute(
    "@",
    Identifier,
    "(",
    AttrTokens,
    ")"))

# cue/format/testdata/imports.txtar / importonly.input (adapted to Lezer)
import "foo"
==>
SourceFile(
  ImportDecl(
    import,
    ImportSpec(
      ImportPath)))

# cue/format/testdata/imports.txtar / imports.input (adapted to Lezer)
package foo

import (
    "cuelang.org/go/foo"
    "cuelang.org/go/bar"
    "time"
)

import (
    time1 "time"

    // comment f2
    f2 "cuelang.org/go/foo"
    f1 "cuelang.org/go/foo"
)

import (
    time2 "time"

    same "cuelang.org/go/foo" // comment 1
    same2 "cuelang.org/go/foo" // comment 2
)


a: time.time
b: foo.foo
c: bar.Bar
==>
SourceFile(
  PackageClause(
    package,
    PackageName(
      Identifier)),
  ImportDecl(
    import,
    "(",
    ImportSpec(
      ImportPath),
    ImportSpec(
      ImportPath),
    ImportSpec(
      ImportPath),
    ")"),
  ImportDecl(
    import,
    "(",
    ImportSpec(
      PackageName(
        Identifier),
      ImportPath),
    Comment,
    ImportSpec(
      PackageName(
        Identifier),
      ImportPath),
    ImportSpec(
      PackageName(
        Identifier),
      ImportPath),
    ")"),
  ImportDecl(
    import,
    "(",
    ImportSpec(
      PackageName(
        Identifier),
      ImportPath),
    ImportSpec(
      PackageName(
        Identifier),
      ImportPath),
    Comment,
    ImportSpec(
      PackageName(
        Identifier),
      ImportPath),
    Comment,
    ")"),
  Declaration(
    Field(
      Label(
        LabelExpr(
          LabelName(
            Identifier))),
      ":",
      AliasExpr(
        Expression(
          PrimaryExpr(
            PrimaryExpr(
              OperandName(
                Identifier)),
            Selector(
              ".",
              Identifier)))))),
  Declaration(
    Field(
      Label(
        LabelExpr(
          LabelName(
            Identifier))),
      ":",
      AliasExpr(
        Expression(
          PrimaryExpr(
            PrimaryExpr(
              OperandName(
                Identifier)),
            Selector(
              ".",
              Identifier)))))),
  Declaration(
    Field(
      Label(
        LabelExpr(
          LabelName(
            Identifier))),
      ":",
      AliasExpr(
        Expression(
          PrimaryExpr(
            PrimaryExpr(
              OperandName(
                Identifier)),
            Selector(
              ".",
              Identifier)))))))

# cue/format/testdata/imports.txtar / lparen-comment.input (adapted to Lezer)
package foo

import ( // c
	"cuelang.org/go/foo"
	"time"
)

a: time.time
b: foo.foo
==>
SourceFile(
  PackageClause(
    package,
    PackageName(
      Identifier)),
  ImportDecl(
    import,
    "(",
    Comment,
    ImportSpec(
      ImportPath),
    ImportSpec(
      ImportPath),
    ")"),
  Declaration(
    Field(
      Label(
        LabelExpr(
          LabelName(
            Identifier))),
      ":",
      AliasExpr(
        Expression(
          PrimaryExpr(
            PrimaryExpr(
              OperandName(
                Identifier)),
            Selector(
              ".",
              Identifier)))))),
  Declaration(
    Field(
      Label(
        LabelExpr(
          LabelName(
            Identifier))),
      ":",
      AliasExpr(
        Expression(
          PrimaryExpr(
            PrimaryExpr(
              OperandName(
                Identifier)),
            Selector(
              ".",
              Identifier)))))))

# cue/format/testdata/imports.txtar / lparen-rparen-comments.input (adapted to Lezer)
package foo

import ( // a
	"time"
) // b

x: time.time
==>
SourceFile(
  PackageClause(
    package,
    PackageName(
      Identifier)),
  ImportDecl(
    import,
    "(",
    Comment,
    ImportSpec(
      ImportPath),
    ")"),
  Comment,
  Declaration(
    Field(
      Label(
        LabelExpr(
          LabelName(
            Identifier))),
      ":",
      AliasExpr(
        Expression(
          PrimaryExpr(
            PrimaryExpr(
              OperandName(
                Identifier)),
            Selector(
              ".",
              Identifier)))))))

# cue/format/testdata/imports.txtar / issue1447.input (adapted to Lezer)
import "strings"

// comment

s: string
u: strings.ToUpper(s)
==>
SourceFile(
  ImportDecl(
    import,
    ImportSpec(
      ImportPath)),
  Comment,
  Declaration(
    Field(
      Label(
        LabelExpr(
          LabelName(
            Identifier))),
      ":",
      AliasExpr(
        Expression(
          PrimaryExpr(
            OperandName(
              Identifier)))))),
  Declaration(
    Field(
      Label(
        LabelExpr(
          LabelName(
            Identifier))),
      ":",
      AliasExpr(
        Expression(
          PrimaryExpr(
            PrimaryExpr(
              PrimaryExpr(
                OperandName(
                  Identifier)),
              Selector(
                ".",
                Identifier)),
            Arguments(
              "(",
              Argument(
                Expression(
                  PrimaryExpr(
                    OperandName(
                      Identifier)))),
              ")")))))))
